Before you tonight is a contract recommended by the Miami senior center board regarding the use of the senior center commercial kitchen by Doc services.
Currently Doc's utilizes the kitchen to prepare meals for our senior population, which is a service we value and want to continue to support.

However, at this time they are not paying rent or utilities for this facility prior to the city taking over operations of the senior center is supported this program by contributing 12,000 annually to the senior center on behalf of Doc's along with providing utility credits.
Since the city assumed operations we've taken on the full cost of maintaining the facility grounds and staffing.
As you can imagine those costs are significant and continuing to absorb them without cost sharing is not sustainable long term.

The contract before you tonight is intended to formalize this relationship and establish a more balanced approach. It allows us to continue supporting meal services for our seniors while also ensuring the city is being fiscally responsible.
We would like to recommend approval of this contract with the adjustment to the terms and rent.
